Thank you for writing in with questions regarding an affiliate account with Rakuten Advertising.
 
Please note that Publishers, also known as affiliates, are people who have websites and want to earn commissions by referring sales. Advertisers are merchants who want to drive sales of their products and services through ads on other websites.
 
If you would like to become a Publisher in the network, it is free! Please find more information and an application form here: http://publisher.rakutenadvertising.com/register. Please feel free to reply with any questions.
 
If you would like to become an advertiser you can find more information and an application here on our website: https://rakutenadvertising.com/form/. If you fill out the application and meet the requirements of our network, a Client Development Manager will contact you.
